messages:
sylvia: Heads up — hosted API 5xx spike started ~13:05 UTC, right after the canary sweep. Support is seeing timeouts and 502/504s. Anyone oncall?
eng-oncall-bot: ALERT: error-rate > 8% on /v1/generate in prod us-west-2 for the last 3m. Canary deployment id=deploy-2026-03-17-sweep flagged. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-5xx
matt: Looking now. Rolling back canary if we confirm. Do we know what config changed in the sweep?
jo: We toggled routing.prefetch_window=0.25 (to reduce batching) and lowered prefix_cache.ttl to 30s for the canary pool. Also enabled a small kernel routing tweak.
emily: Edge traces show gateway 504s and upstream read timeouts. Quick sample from proxy logs:
```
HTTP/1.1 504 Upstream read timeout
handler=proxy id=route-e7 error=KVCACHE-MISS upstream=droplet-canary-3
```
sylvia: @matt @jo support provided repro: lots of short requests (seq <50) -> ~30% 5xx within canary nodes. Several paying customers flagged billing/latency complaints.
matt: Rolling back canary to v2026-03-10 now. Pausing autoscale and sweep jobs. ETA ~2m.
support-liaison: Notified affected customers (acme-inc, healthai, chatly). Raised support tickets and offered region failover keys.
jo: My hypothesis: TTL drop increased prefix cache churn; short requests lose cached prefixes and cause synchronous KV fetches that saturate the canary KV route path. Combined with the prefetch_window shrink, we reduced batching so more small requests hit the backend. Planning: revert prefetch_window to 1.0 in dark canary and re-run perf microbench.
emily: Telemetry shows p50 latency for canary doubled, token-per-request cost spiked. Correlation ids: cid=0x9f3a1c, cid=0x7b4e9d (attaching logs to the ticket).
sylvia: :thumbsup: Rollback finished — error-rate back to baseline (~0.6%) within 4m. Next steps: postmortem and stricter gating on cache/ttl flips. Assigning jo + matt to draft follow-up.
matt: Will open PR for rollout policy changes and add perf e2e for short-request patterns. cc @emily for telemetry assertions.
eng-oncall-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: transient canary config change caused KV route churn -> 5xx spike. See runbook and follow-up checklist: https://redwood.internal/incidents/6364123456 :white_check_mark:
